lines.text: Hi, I don't think we've met. I'm Priya.
Hi Priya, nice to meet you. I'm Aman.
Nice to meet you too. So, what do you do?
I'm a software developer. How about you?
I work in marketing. How do you know the host?
We went to college together. It's a small world!
Hi, what can I get for you?
Could I get a cappuccino, please?
Sure. Would you like a small or large?
A large, please. And a piece of cake.
Great. That will be 250 rupees.
Here you go. Thank you!
Excuse me, could you help me?
Of course. What are you looking for?
How do I get to the railway station?
Go straight and turn left at the traffic light.
Is it far from here?
No, just a five-minute walk. You can't miss it.
Thank you so much!
Hello, this is Priya speaking.
Hi Priya, it's Aman. Is this a good time to talk?
Yes, go ahead. How can I help?
I wanted to ask about tomorrow's meeting.
Sure. It's at 11 am in the main office.
Perfect. Thanks a lot. See you then!
Good morning. What seems to be the problem?
I've had a bad headache for two days.
I see. Do you have a fever as well?
A little. I also feel very tired.
Okay. I'll prescribe some medicine. Get plenty of rest.
Thank you, doctor. How often should I take it?
Twice a day, after meals.
Thanks for coming in. Tell me a little about yourself.
Sure. I have three years of experience in sales.
Why do you want to work with us?
I admire your company and want to grow my skills here.
What are your strengths?
I'm hardworking and I communicate well with the team.
Great. Do you have any questions for us?
Yes, what does a typical day look like in this role?
Hello, can I help you find anything?
Yes, I'm looking for a blue shirt.
Sure. What size are you?
Medium, please. Do you have this one in medium?
Let me check. Yes, here you are.
Can I try it on?
Of course, the changing room is over there.
Hey, are you free this weekend?
I think so. What do you have in mind?
How about we watch a movie on Saturday?
Sounds good! What time works for you?
Let's meet at 6 pm outside the mall.
Perfect. See you then. Can't wait!
Hi, do you have a minute?
Sure, what's up?
I'm stuck on this report. Could you give me a hand?
No problem. Let me take a look.
Thanks. I really appreciate it.
Anytime. Let's go through it together.
I think we should launch the product next week.
I see your point, but I'm afraid it's too soon.
Why do you say that?
We still need more testing to avoid problems.
That's a fair point. What do you suggest?
Let's push it back by two weeks to be safe.
Alright, that makes sense. Let's do that.
Good evening. How can I help you?
I'm sorry to bother you, but the AC in my room isn't working.
Oh, I apologize for the inconvenience.
Would it be possible to fix it or change my room?
Of course. I'll send someone right away.
Thank you. I really appreciate your help.
Thanks everyone for joining. Let's get started.
Sure. I'd like to share the sales numbers first.
Please go ahead.
Sales are up by 20 percent this quarter.
That's excellent news. What's driving the growth?
Mainly our new online campaign.
Great work. Let's discuss how we can build on that.
Good morning. How can I help you?
Hi, I'd like to open a savings account.
Sure. Do you have your ID and address proof?
Yes, here they are.
Great. Please fill out this form.
Okay. How long will it take?
Your account will be ready in about ten minutes.
Hello, I'm calling about the flat for rent.
Yes, it's still available. Would you like to see it?
That would be great. How much is the rent?
It's fifteen thousand a month, plus a deposit.
Are utilities included?
Water is included, but electricity is separate.
I see. Can I visit it this weekend?
Welcome! Please come in.
Thank you for having me.
Can I get you something to drink?
A glass of water would be lovely, thanks.
Please, make yourself at home.
You have a beautiful house.
Hi, I'd like to return this shirt.
Sure. Is there a problem with it?
Yes, it's the wrong size.
No problem. Do you have the receipt?
Yes, here it is.
Would you like a refund or an exchange?
An exchange, please. A larger size.
You look great today!
Oh, thank you! That's kind of you.
I really like your jacket.
Thanks, I got it last week.
It suits you very well.
You just made my day!
So, what line of work are you in?
I work in digital marketing. And you?
I run a small design studio.
That's interesting. How did you get started?
I started freelancing and it grew from there.
Impressive. We should stay in touch.
Absolutely. Here's my card.
